title: FlyLo continuation rules
summary: Continue airline functionality on top of the shared engine and Wire UI components. Row/list mechanics are platform work; FlyLo should consume the current qualified shared implementation and spend application effort on airline semantics such as flight status and disruption servicing.
rules: Before row/list work, inspect current Wire UI documentation/artifacts and reuse the shared implementation.
Keep Grok real-time, structured and non-authoritative; no passenger-chat Batch path.
Preserve durable Queue/accounting state and exact semantic identities across restart.
Treat Flight Status and disruption information as Operations authority; rebooking/refund requires a separate controlled command path.
Do not activate tax, settlement or other newer Accounting Core policy merely because the APIs exist; airline policy must be explicit.

provenance.claim: Shared row/list capability is a Federation-company platform concern.
